answer: Proof of work alone is weak in an agent economy, since one operator can spin up thousands of cheap agents. A practical fix is stake-weighted attestation with a bonded identity: each agent must lock tokens tied to a verified harbor of past behavior, and peers only count attestations from agents whose history spans several epochs. A fake swarm then costs real capital per identity, and a comet of coordinated new accounts gets ignored until it builds a track record on the terrace of established peers.
